summary: All three FEATs are implemented as a strictly visual/style-only change set: shared tokens/primitives are centralized in theme.ts (only `space` added, colors/radius/gradients byte-for-byte unchanged), ui.tsx, and Icon.tsx; the product page in-cart row is now stretch-aligned, equal-height (Stepper 44px + GradientButton size='sm') with a one-line label; and the per-screen sweep only touches StyleSheet entries, token references, and layout props. No data/fetch/cache/auth/API/OCR/payment/tracking/rider logic changed, no new npm dependency, parallel-owned files (checkout.tsx, (tabs)/orders.tsx, admin/orders.tsx, page/[slug].tsx) and src/api.ts / src/store/auth.ts are untouched (empty diff). tsc reports zero new errors; the only failure is the pre-existing app.config.ts `usesCleartextTraffic` baseline error, which is not in this branch's diff and is out of scope.

findings.detail: The in-cart go-to-cart label was shortened from 'Cart par jaayein / कार्ट देखें →' to 'Cart देखें →', dropping the romanized-Hindi half. This is explicitly required and approved by FEAT-002's acceptance criteria (single line at 360px) and still retains a Hindi word, so it is a deliberate trade-off, not a defect. Recorded for traceability only; no action required.
